name: finish_trade_checks_not_atomic.order
description: TF.order (question), `finish_trade_checks_not_atomic`: whether creating the short account's lien (`create_initial_margin_source_lien_if_needed(short_account)`) can change anything the long account's certificate was computed from, so that a fresh certification of the long account after it would give a lower `certified_equity` or a higher `certified_initial_req` than the stored certificate that `ensure_initial_margin` then checks. Answer to be stated precisely: what the certificate depends on, and what the short lien creation writes.

name: Spec.Trade.tf_margin
description: TF.margin, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::finish_trade_checks_not_atomic`: for all inputs and all well-formed starting states, if the call returns `Ok(())`, then each account whose `long_requires_initial_margin` / `short_requires_initial_margin` argument is true has, at the return, a valid `health_cert` with `certified_equity >= 0` and `certified_equity >= certified_initial_req`. Proved from the function body, assuming TC9 (`create_initial_margin_source_lien_if_needed`) and the contracts of `ensure_initial_margin` / `ensure_no_positive_credit_initial_margin` (which wrap the `kernel_initial_margin_gate` / `kernel_locked_margin_gate` checks) as hypotheses.

name: Spec.Trade.tf_locked
description: TF.locked, `finish_trade_checks_not_atomic`: if `locked` is true and the call returns `Ok(())`, then each account whose `*_requires_initial_margin` argument is true has, at the return, `capital + min(pnl, 0) - |fee_credits| >= certified_initial_req`, with that left side not negative (fields at the return). Proved from the function body, assuming TC9 and the contracts of `ensure_initial_margin` / `ensure_no_positive_credit_initial_margin` (the latter wraps `kernel_locked_margin_gate`).

name: Spec.Trade.tf_frame
description: TF.frame, `finish_trade_checks_not_atomic`: on an `Ok(())` return, (a) when `risk_increasing` is false or `locked` is true nothing at all was written (header, market slots, the view's `protection_observed`, both accounts); (b) in every case neither account has a written field other than `capital`, `health_cert` and `source_domains`, and the header has no written field other than `backing_provider_earnings_total`, `c_tot`, `risk_epoch`, `source_claim_bound_total_num`, `source_fresh_backing_total_num` and `source_insurance_credit_reserved_total_atoms`. Proved from the body assuming TC9 and the `ensure_*` margin contracts.

name: Spec.Trade.tc9_im_lien
description: TC9, `create_initial_margin_source_lien_if_needed(account)`: on `Ok(())` the account's `health_cert` is valid at the return; it writes no account field other than `capital`, `health_cert` and `source_domains`, and no header field other than `backing_provider_earnings_total`, `c_tot`, `risk_epoch`, `source_claim_bound_total_num`, `source_fresh_backing_total_num` and `source_insurance_credit_reserved_total_atoms` (market slots are not constrained, as in the stated TC9). It is not passed the other account, so it cannot write it. Deep contract: attempted only after everything else.

name: Spec.Trade.tc7_recertify
description: TC7, `recertify_account_after_trade_delta(account, asset_index, old_abs_q, new_abs_q, price)` (takes `&self`): writes nothing in the market (header, slots, `protection_observed`), and in the account at most `health_cert`.

name: transfer_trade_residual_reward_credit.frame
description: TC6, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::transfer_trade_residual_reward_credit(long_account, short_account, &trade_preflight, asset_index)` (takes `&self`): writes nothing in the market (header, slots, `protection_observed`), and in the two accounts at most `residual_received_atoms_total` and `residual_spent_principal_atoms_total`; the `trade_preflight` it borrows is unchanged (and given back if it panics).

name: Spec.Trade.tc5_position_delta
description: TC5 (strengthened), `apply_current_position_delta_with_lookup(account, asset_index, delta_q, lookup)`: on `Ok(())` it has written no header field other than `resolved_payout_blocker_count` and `risk_epoch`, no account field other than `active_bitmap`, `health_cert`, `legs` and `liquidation_lock`, and no market slot other than the slot of `asset_index`; with `delta_q != 0` the account's signed raw position on `asset_index` is `lookup.next_q` afterwards and its legs on other assets are unchanged; with `delta_q == 0` nothing at all is written. Deep contract: attempted only after everything else.

name: Spec.Trade.tc4_terminal_residual
description: TC4 (strengthened), `begin_terminal_trade_residual_if_needed(account, asset_index, lookup, is_final_batch_fill, attributable_asset_before_refresh)`: on `Ok(())` it has written no header field other than `resolved_payout_blocker_count`, no account field other than `close_progress`, and no market slot other than the slot of `asset_index`; and nothing at all when `is_final_batch_fill` is false, when `lookup.current_q == 0` or `lookup.next_q != 0`, or when `account.header.pnl >= 0`.

name: Spec.Trade.tc3_risk_change
description: TC3, `require_asset_risk_change_allowed(asset_index, risk_increasing)` (takes `&self`): writes nothing; with `risk_increasing` true it returns `Ok(())` only if the slot of `asset_index` exists and its asset's stored `a_long` and `a_short` both equal `ADL_ONE`.

name: Spec.Trade.tc2_preflight
description: TC2, `validate_trade_position_preflight(&long_view, &short_view, request, long_lookup, short_lookup)` (takes `&self`): writes nothing, and on `Ok(p)`: `p.long_lookup == long_lookup`, `p.short_lookup == short_lookup`, `p.long_old_abs_q == |long_lookup.current_effective_q|`, `p.long_new_abs_q == |long_lookup.next_effective_q|`, the same for short, and `p.risk_increasing` is true exactly when `|next_effective_q| > |current_effective_q|` for at least one of the two lookups.

name: Spec.Trade.tc1_charge_fee
description: TC1, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::charge_account_fee_current_not_atomic(account, requested_fee)`, proved from its body (no callee contract), in the no-panic form (`np = true`: no execution panics): if it returns `Ok(charged)`, then `charged == 0` if `requested_fee == 0` or `account.header.pnl < 0`, else `min(requested_fee, account.header.capital)`; if `charged == 0` nothing is written; otherwise exactly `capital` (lowered by `charged`), `m.header.c_tot` (lowered by `charged`, with `charged <= c_tot`), `m.header.insurance` (raised by `charged`) and `health_cert.valid` (set to 0) are written; `vault`, the market slots and all else are not.

name: Spec.Trade.tb_flag
description: TB.flag, `execute_batch_with_fee_loss_stale_scoped_not_atomic(long_account, short_account, requests)` with `execute_batch_with_fee_after_tail_validation_not_atomic` treated as an opaque call (any writes to the market and the two accounts, `Ok` or `Err`, described by an arbitrary relation `Ψ`). Every return, `Ok` or `Err`, is either an `Err` before the opaque call with nothing written, or comes after it; then, for the value `ignore` of `ignore_unrelated_loss_stale`: if `ignore` is true the opaque call started with `loss_stale_active == 0` and the state left has `loss_stale_active == f0` (its value at entry), everything else being the opaque call's final state; if `ignore` is false the entry point itself wrote nothing (in particular not the flag). `ignore` is true exactly when `f0 == 1`, `requests` is non-empty and `can_ignore_unrelated_loss_stale_for_trade` returned `Ok(true)` for the asset of every request (the loop stops at the first `Ok(false)`). Covers returns only; panics are not constrained.

name: Spec.Trade.tb_checked
description: TB.checked, `execute_batch_with_fee_loss_stale_scoped_not_atomic`: every `Ok` return is preceded, on the final state, by an `Ok` return of `validate_shape()` and of `validate_with_market` for both accounts, with no write in between: the final state satisfies whatever an `Ok` return of those validators guarantees (arbitrary relations `Θ`, `Λ` given by their contracts).

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.positions
description: TA.positions, `apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`, with an added precondition: for each account and its lookup `lk` from `position_lookups`, if `lk.next_q != lk.current_q` or the account's signed raw position on `request.asset_index` at entry already equals `lk.current_q`, then on an `Ok` return the account's signed raw position on `request.asset_index` is `lk.next_q` (an absent or inactive leg, or an active leg with raw basis 0, counts as 0) and its legs on every other asset are unchanged. Assumes TC2, TC5 and the other callee contracts.

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.nopanic
description: TA.nopanic, `apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`: if every called method satisfies its contract and does not panic, no execution of the function panics (it may return `Err`). The body has no arithmetic operator or indexing of its own; its only arithmetic is `checked_sub(..).ok_or(..)` and `?` propagation, which return `Err` instead of panicking.

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.gate
description: TA.gate, `apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`: on an `Ok` return the slot of `request.asset_index` exists before and after, and for each side the effective open interest after the call (`oi_eff_long_q`, `oi_eff_short_q` of that slot) is at most `MAX_OI_SIDE_Q` or at most its value at entry (the value read before the two position changes). This is exactly what `kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate` (TC8/K17) guarantees between the two reads of the asset state; nothing after the second read writes the slot. Assumes the callee contracts.

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.frame
description: TA.frame, `apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`: an `Ok` call writes no header field other than `c_tot`, `insurance`, `resolved_payout_blocker_count` and `risk_epoch`; no account field other than `active_bitmap`, `capital`, `close_progress`, `health_cert`, `legs`, `liquidation_lock`, `residual_received_atoms_total` and `residual_spent_principal_atoms_total`; and no market slot other than the slot of `request.asset_index`. Assumes TC1-TC7 (TC4 strengthened to also write no slot other than that of `asset_index`; TC5 strengthened to write nothing when `delta_q == 0`) and the other callee contracts.

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.fee
description: TA.fee, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`: with `fee = checked_fee_bps(trade_fee_notional_ceil(|request.size_q|, request.exec_price), request.fee_bps)` (as mathematical functions: the ceiling of `|size_q| * exec_price / POS_SCALE`, then the fee in basis points), every `Ok(outcome)` return has `outcome.fee_a == 0` if `fee == 0` or `L.header.pnl < 0`, else `min(fee, L.header.capital)` (values at entry), the same for `outcome.fee_b` with `S`, hence both `<= fee`; and `outcome.notional == floor(|request.size_q| * request.exec_price / POS_SCALE)`. Proved from the function body assuming the callee contracts TC1-TC8 and the contracts of `trade_notional_floor`, `trade_fee_notional_ceil`, `checked_fee_bps`, `asset_state` and `effective_abs_q_for_raw_basis` (and K58 `trade_signed_size_deltas`).

name: apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic.conservation
description: TA.conservation, `apply_trade_after_refresh_not_atomic`: on an `Ok(outcome)` return, `m'.header.vault == m.header.vault`; `outcome.fee_a + outcome.fee_b <= m.header.c_tot`, `m'.header.c_tot == m.header.c_tot - outcome.fee_a - outcome.fee_b` and `m'.header.insurance == m.header.insurance + outcome.fee_a + outcome.fee_b`; `L'.header.capital == L.header.capital - outcome.fee_a`, `S'.header.capital == S.header.capital - outcome.fee_b` (no underflow); `L'.header.pnl == L.header.pnl` and `S'.header.pnl == S.header.pnl`. Assumes the callee contracts TC1-TC8 (and those of the fee/notional helpers, `asset_state`, `effective_abs_q_for_raw_basis`).

name: register_empty_materialized_portfolio_not_atomic.h_preserved
description: T47 `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::register_empty_materialized_portfolio_not_atomic(account)`: for every market view satisfying H and every 9419-byte `PortfolioV16View` account, if the call returns `Ok(())`, then the only header field written is `materialized_portfolio_count` (raised by one), the market slots and the portfolio account are unchanged, and H holds afterwards.

name: Spec.LayerT.t33_header
description: T33 `finalize_side_reset_not_atomic(asset_index, side)` (on `MarketGroupV16ViewMut<'_, ()>`): for every market view satisfying H and all arguments, if the call returns `Ok(())`, then either the header is unchanged (side already `Normal`) or the only header fields written are `resolved_payout_blocker_count` (through `set_asset_state`) and `risk_epoch` (raised by one); the slice of market slots keeps its length; and H holds afterwards.

name: deregister_empty_materialized_portfolio_not_atomic.h_preserved
description: T29 `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::deregister_empty_materialized_portfolio_not_atomic(account)`: for every market view satisfying H and every 9419-byte `PortfolioV16View` account, if the call returns `Ok(())`, then the only header field written is `materialized_portfolio_count` (lowered by one), the market slots and the portfolio account are unchanged, and H holds afterwards.

name: advance_terminal_slab_not_atomic.scan_progress.h_preserved
description: T10 `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, ()>::advance_terminal_slab_not_atomic(authenticated_slot, scan_start_asset_index)`, `ScanProgress` returns. For every market view satisfying H and all arguments, if the call returns `Ok(TerminalSlabOutcomeV16::ScanProgress { .. })`, then the only header field written is `current_slot` (now `authenticated_slot`). The market slots are unchanged, and H holds afterwards.

name: activate_empty_market_slot_not_atomic.market.hh_preserved
description: T05 `MarketGroupV16HeaderAccount::activate_empty_market_slot_not_atomic::<Market<()>>(asset_index, slot, authenticated_price, now_slot)`: makes the same claim as the `EngineAssetSlotV16Account` instance. On `Ok(())`, `now_slot >=` the old `current_slot`, and only the six activation fields of the header are written (`asset_slot_capacity` and `config` are unchanged). Hh holds afterwards.

name: activate_empty_market_slot_not_atomic.engine_slot.hh_preserved
description: T05 `MarketGroupV16HeaderAccount::activate_empty_market_slot_not_atomic::<EngineAssetSlotV16Account>(asset_index, slot, authenticated_price, now_slot)`: for every header account satisfying Hh (all fields in range), every 1365-byte slot and all `u32`/`u64` arguments, if the call returns `Ok(())`, then `now_slot >=` the old `current_slot`; the header left behind differs only in `next_market_id`, `asset_activation_count`, `asset_set_epoch`, `risk_epoch` (each raised by one) and `current_slot`, `last_asset_activation_slot` (both now `now_slot`), so `asset_slot_capacity` and `config` are unchanged; and Hh holds of it.

name: activate_empty_asset_slot_not_atomic.hh_preserved
description: T03 `MarketGroupV16HeaderAccount::activate_empty_asset_slot_not_atomic(asset_index, slot, authenticated_price, now_slot)` calls T05 at `EngineAssetSlotV16Account`. On `Ok(())`, `now_slot >=` the old `current_slot`, and only the six activation fields of the header are written (`asset_slot_capacity` and `config` are unchanged). Hh holds afterwards.

name: Spec.LayerT.t02_header
description: T02 `accrue_asset_to_not_atomic(asset_index, now_slot, effective_price, funding_rate_e9, protective_progress_committed)` (on `MarketGroupV16ViewMut<'_, ()>`): for every market view satisfying H and all arguments, if the call returns `Ok(_)`, then the only header fields written are `current_slot` (now `max(current_slot, now_slot)`), `slot_last` (now at most `now_slot`), `loss_stale_active` (now 0 or 1), `oracle_epoch`, `funding_epoch` and `resolved_payout_blocker_count`; the slice keeps its length; and H holds afterwards. No assumption beyond H at entry.

name: Spec.LayerT.t01_header
description: T01 `accrue_asset_path_to_not_atomic(asset_index, now_slot, raw_oracle_target_price, steps, protective_progress_committed)` (on `MarketGroupV16ViewMut<'_, ()>`): for every market view satisfying H and all arguments, if the call returns `Ok(_)`, then `now_slot` was at least the old `current_slot`, and the only header fields written are `current_slot` (now `now_slot`), `slot_last` (now at most `now_slot`), `loss_stale_active` (now 0 or 1), `oracle_epoch`, `funding_epoch` and `resolved_payout_blocker_count`; the slice keeps its length; the steps are unchanged; and H holds afterwards.

name: MarketGroupV16ViewMut::leg_kf_delta_components_for_settlement_from_asset.p13_p14_no_e5_panic
description: P13 and P14, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, T>::leg_kf_delta_components_for_settlement_from_asset(asset, leg)` (class leg): for every `asset` and every `leg` for which `validate_active_leg(leg)` returns `Ok(())`, no execution reaches either call `wide_signed_mul_div_floor_from_k_pair(leg.basis_pos_q.unsigned_abs(), leg.k_snap / leg.f_snap, k_now / f_now, den)` with arguments in its E5 panic condition.

name: PortfolioLegV16Account::try_to_runtime.pl1_active_leg_validated
description: PL1, `PortfolioLegV16Account::try_to_runtime(&self)`: for every account (arbitrary field bytes), the function has no undefined behaviour, and it returns `Ok(leg)` with `leg.active` only if `validate_active_leg(leg)` returns `Ok(())` (proved for every behaviour of `validate_active_leg`: whatever leg set it accepts, an active returned leg lies in it). With the actual `validate_active_leg`, an active returned leg satisfies `a_basis == ADL_ONE`, (`basis_pos_q == 0` or `|basis_pos_q| <= MAX_POSITION_ABS_Q`), `k_snap`, `f_snap`, `basis_pos_q != i128::MIN`, `0 < loss_weight <= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`, `b_rem < SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`, `b_epoch_snap == epoch_snap`.

name: scaled_adl_delta_fast.p21_no_e3_panic
description: P21, `scaled_adl_delta_fast` (class local): for all inputs, no execution reaches the call `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128(numerator, POS_SCALE)` with arguments in its E3 panic condition. Reason: `d = POS_SCALE = 10^6 > 1`.

name: scaled_adl_delta_fast.p20_no_e3_panic
description: P20, `scaled_adl_delta_fast` (class local): for all inputs, no execution reaches the call `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128(numerator, den)` with arguments in its E3 panic condition. Reason: `den = ADL_ONE.checked_mul(POS_SCALE)? = 10^21 > 1`.

name: V16Core::kernel_adl_scaled_accrual_index_deltas.p06_no_e3_panic
description: P06, `V16Core::kernel_adl_scaled_accrual_index_deltas` (class local): for all inputs, no execution reaches the second call `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128(.., FUNDING_DEN)` (the short side) with arguments in its E3 panic condition. Reason: `d = FUNDING_DEN = 10^9 > 1`. The call occurs only in the branch where `funding_num % FUNDING_DEN != 0`, after the P05 call has returned.

name: V16Core::kernel_adl_scaled_accrual_index_deltas.p05_no_e3_panic
description: P05, `V16Core::kernel_adl_scaled_accrual_index_deltas` (class local): for all `price_delta`, `funding_num: i128`, `a_long`, `a_short: u128`, no execution reaches the first call `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128(f_long_num, FUNDING_DEN)` with arguments in its E3 panic condition (`d = 0`, or `n = i128::MIN` and `d = 1`). Reason: `d = FUNDING_DEN = 10^9 > 1`. The call occurs only in the branch where `funding_num % FUNDING_DEN != 0`.

name: V16Core::crystallize_source_lien_fee_for_effective.p04_no_f3_panic
description: P04, `V16Core::crystallize_source_lien_fee_for_effective(source: &mut PortfolioSourceDomainV16Account, impaired_effective: u128)` (class local): for every `impaired_effective` and every account `*source` (arbitrary field contents), no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(live_fee, impaired_effective, live_effective)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition. Reason, as the spec states: the call is reached only when `0 < impaired_effective < live_effective`, so the quotient is at most `live_fee`.

name: f_snap_after_settlement.p22_no_d5_panic
description: P22, `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, f_snap, f_now, f_delta)` (class local): for all inputs, no execution reaches the call `mul_div_floor_u256_with_rem(..)` with arguments in its D5 panic condition. Reason, as the spec states: on the path to the call `abs_basis != 0` (early return otherwise) and `d = U256::from_u128(abs_basis)`, while `a`, `b` come from `u128` values, so `a*b < 2^256`.

name: trade_notional_floor.p17_no_d5_panic
description: P17, `trade_notional_floor(size_q: u128, exec_price: u64)` (class local): for all inputs, no execution reaches the call `mul_div_floor_u256_with_rem(U256::from_u128(size_q), U256::from_u128(exec_price as u128), U256::from_u128(POS_SCALE))` with arguments in its D5 panic condition (`val(d) = 0` or `floor(val(a)*val(b)/val(d)) >= 2^256`). Reason, as the spec states: `d = POS_SCALE = 10^6`, and `a`, `b` come from `u128` values, so `a*b < 2^256`.

name: MarketGroupV16ViewMut::resolved_receipt_claimable_against_ledger.p15_no_f3_panic
description: P15, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, T>::resolved_receipt_claimable_against_ledger(receipt, ledger)` (class ledger), for every `T`: for every `receipt: ResolvedPayoutReceiptV16` and every `ledger: ResolvedPayoutLedgerV16` with `1 <= ledger.current_payout_rate_den` and `ledger.current_payout_rate_num <= ledger.current_payout_rate_den`, no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(receipt.terminal_positive_claim_face, ledger.current_payout_rate_num, ledger.current_payout_rate_den)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition (the quotient is at most the claim face).

name: V16Core::kernel_recompute_resolved_payout_rate.pr1_rate_in_unit_interval
description: PR1, `V16Core::kernel_recompute_resolved_payout_rate(ledger)`: for every input `ledger: ResolvedPayoutLedgerV16`, the function has no undefined behaviour, and if it returns `Ok(l)` then `1 <= l.current_payout_rate_den` and `l.current_payout_rate_num <= l.current_payout_rate_den`; all other fields of `l` equal those of `ledger`.

name: V16Core::kernel_resolved_receipt_can_still_gain.p07_no_f3_panic
description: P07, `V16Core::kernel_resolved_receipt_can_still_gain` (class ledger): for every `ledger: ResolvedPayoutLedgerV16` with `ledger.current_payout_rate_den != 0`, every `source_fresh_backing_total_num: u128` and every `receipt: ResolvedPayoutReceiptV16`, no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(receipt.terminal_positive_claim_face, best_rate_num, ledger.current_payout_rate_den)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition. Only `current_payout_rate_den != 0` is needed (not `num <= den`): `best_rate_num = (..).min(current_payout_rate_den)`, so the quotient is at most the claim face.

name: MarketGroupV16ViewMut::haircut_effective_support.p09_no_f3_panic
description: P09, `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, T>::haircut_effective_support` (class local), for every `T`: for every `&self` and all `face_claim`, `residual`, `junior_bound: u128`, no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(face_claim, residual, junior_bound)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition. Reason, as the spec states: on the path to the call `junior_bound != 0` and `residual < junior_bound`, so the quotient is at most `face_claim`.

name: V16Core::source_lien_fee_after_backing_release.p03_no_f3_panic
description: P03, `V16Core::source_lien_fee_after_backing_release` (class local): for all `fee_revenue`, `backing_before`, `backing_after: u128`, no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(fee_revenue, backing_after, backing_before)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition. Reason, as the spec states: on the path to the call `backing_before != 0` and `backing_after < backing_before`, so the quotient is at most `fee_revenue`.

name: backing_domain_fee_split_for_lien_delta_num.p01_no_f3_panic
description: P01, `backing_domain_fee_split_for_lien_delta_num` (class local): for all `lien_delta_num: u128`, `fee_bps: u16`, `insurance_share_bps: u16`, no execution reaches the call `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(total_fee, insurance_share_bps as u128, MAX_MARGIN_BPS as u128)` with arguments in its F3 panic condition (`d = 0` or `floor(a*b/d) >= 2^128`). Reason, as the spec states: `d = 10_000`, and `insurance_share_bps <= 10_000` is checked above, so the quotient is at most `total_fee`.

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_contract
description: KI.contract (as written): for all inputs, if `V16Core::kernel_accrual_index_update(k_long, k_short, f_long, f_short, a_long, a_short, price_delta, funding_num)` returns, its result satisfies the `kani::ensures` clause above the function, literally (including `dfl.checked_mul(fd).map_or(false, ..)` and `dfs.checked_mul(fd).map_or(false, ..)` in the branch where `funding_num` is not a multiple of `fd`).

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_path
description: KI.path: (1) if `V16Core::kernel_accrual_index_update(..)` returns `Ok((kl, ks, fl, fs))`, then `kl - k_long == price_delta * a_long` and `ks - k_short == -(price_delta * a_short)` (exact integers); (2) for two successive calls with the same `a_long` and `a_short`, the second starting from the first one's results, with price deltas `d1` then `d2` and any funding amounts, if both return `Ok`, the K indices after the second are `k_long + (d1 + d2) * a_long` and `k_short - (d1 + d2) * a_short`.

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_mark_to_market

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_funding_conserves

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_floors

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_index_update_nopanic

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_funding_num_nopanic

name: Spec.Seg.kernel_accrual_price_move_within_cap_nopanic

name: Spec.KR.kernel_bankruptcy_residual_step_capacity_nopanic

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_cadence
description: KF.cadence: fix `abs_basis > 0` and `a_basis` with `den = a_basis * POS_SCALE <= u128::MAX`, a snapshot `s_0` and `n >= 1` index values `b_1, ..., b_n` (any order). Settle successively with `d_i = fl(s_(i-1), b_i)` and `s_i` the `Ok` result of `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, s_(i-1), b_i, d_i)`. If all `n` calls return `Ok`, then with `T = fl(s_0, b_n)`: `d_1 + ... + d_n <= T`, `(T - (d_1 + ... + d_n)) * den < den + n * abs_basis`, and the sum equals `T` when `den` is a multiple of `abs_basis`. The chain is made of calls of the function itself and the proof is by induction on `n`.

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_ok_exact
description: KF.ok, exact error condition and corrected `Ok` claim: with `abs_basis > 0`, `den = a_basis * POS_SCALE <= u128::MAX` and `f_delta == fl(f_snap, f_now)` (any `a_basis`), `f_snap_after_settlement` does not panic and returns `Err(ArithmeticOverflow)` exactly when `f_snap != f_now` and either `a_basis == 0` or, with `step = ceil(f_delta * den / abs_basis)`, `step` is outside `[-(2^127 - 1), 2^127 - 1]`, or `f_snap + step < i128::MIN`, or `f_now - (f_snap + step) > i128::MAX`; otherwise it returns `Ok(s)` with `s` an `i128`. If also `a_basis > 0` (added precondition), `|f_now - f_snap| + den <= i128::MAX` and `f_now - den >= i128::MIN`, it returns `Ok`.

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_carry_of_pos
description: KF.carry, corrected with the added precondition `a_basis > 0`: with `abs_basis > 0`, `a_basis > 0`, `den = a_basis * POS_SCALE <= u128::MAX` and `f_delta == fl(f_snap, f_now)`, `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, f_snap, f_now, f_delta)` does not panic, and if it returns `Ok(s)` then (i) `s <= f_now` and `abs_basis * (f_now - s) < den`, and (ii) `f_delta * den <= abs_basis * (s - f_snap) < f_delta * den + abs_basis`.

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_nopanic
description: KF.nopanic: for all `u128` `abs_basis`, `a_basis` and `i128` `f_snap`, `f_now`, `f_delta`, no execution of `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, f_snap, f_now, f_delta)` panics. The calls into `mul_div_floor_u256_with_rem`, `U256::from_u128` and `try_into_u128` are covered by the earlier results D5, A1 and A3, whose proofs are reused for this build.

name: Spec.KF.scaled_adl_delta_fast_delta
description: KF.delta: for all `u128` `abs_basis_q`, `a_basis` and `i128` `then`, `now`, `scaled_adl_delta_fast(abs_basis_q, a_basis, then, now)` never panics, and if it returns `Some(x)` then `x = floor(abs_basis_q * (now - then) / (a_basis * POS_SCALE))` (rounded toward minus infinity). The call into `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128` is covered by the earlier result E3, whose proof is reused for this build.

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_ok
description: KF.ok as stated (the `Ok` part): under the hypotheses of KF.carry (`abs_basis > 0`, `den = a_basis * POS_SCALE <= u128::MAX`, `f_delta == fl(f_snap, f_now)`), if in addition `|f_now - f_snap| + den <= i128::MAX` and `f_now - den >= i128::MIN`, then `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, f_snap, f_now, f_delta)` returns `Ok`.

name: Spec.KF.f_snap_after_settlement_carry
description: KF.carry as stated: with `abs_basis > 0`, `den = a_basis * POS_SCALE <= u128::MAX` and `f_delta == fl(f_snap, f_now)`, if `f_snap_after_settlement(abs_basis, a_basis, f_snap, f_now, f_delta)` returns `Ok(s)` then (i) `s <= f_now` and `abs_basis * (f_now - s) < den`, and (ii) `f_delta * den <= abs_basis * (s - f_snap) < f_delta * den + abs_basis`.

name: Spec.Accrual.canonical_accrual_price_step_v16_reaches_of_valid
description: KP.reaches with an added precondition: under the same chain as KP.envelope (fixed `target`, `cap_anchor`, `max_change_bps`, `exposed = true`, `n` calls from `p_0: u64`, `r_0: u16`, all returning `Ok`), if `n >= 1 || r_0 < MAX_MARGIN_BPS` and `n * cap_anchor * max_change_bps + r_0 >= |target - p_0| * MAX_MARGIN_BPS`, then `p_n == target`.

name: Spec.Accrual.canonical_accrual_price_step_v16_reaches
description: KP.reaches (as stated): under the same chain as KP.envelope (fixed `target`, `cap_anchor`, `max_change_bps`, `exposed = true`, `n` calls from `p_0: u64`, `r_0: u16`, all returning `Ok`), if `n * cap_anchor * max_change_bps + r_0 >= |target - p_0| * MAX_MARGIN_BPS` then `p_n == target`.

name: Spec.Accrual.canonical_accrual_price_step_v16_envelope
description: KP.envelope: fix `target`, `cap_anchor`, `max_change_bps` (any `u64`) and `exposed = true`. For a chain of `n` calls of `canonical_accrual_price_step_v16` from price `p_0: u64` and remainder `r_0: u16`, each fed the previous call's `Ok((price, remainder))`, if all `n` calls return `Ok`, then `|p_n - p_0| * MAX_MARGIN_BPS <= n * cap_anchor * max_change_bps + r_0` in exact integers, and `p_n` lies between `p_0` and `target` inclusive. Since this holds for every `n`, it holds for every intermediate price `p_i`.

name: Spec.Accrual.canonical_accrual_price_step_v16_nopanic
description: KP.nopanic: for every `current`, `target`, `cap_anchor`, `max_change_bps: u64`, `exposed: bool` and `remainder_before_bps_num: u16`, no execution of `canonical_accrual_price_step_v16(..)` panics (it never unwinds, including through arithmetic-overflow checks).

description: KP.contract: for every `current`, `target`, `cap_anchor`, `max_change_bps: u64`, `exposed: bool` and `remainder_before_bps_num: u16`, if `canonical_accrual_price_step_v16(..)` returns, its result is a `V16Result<(u64, u16)>` satisfying the function's `kani::ensures` clause (read in exact integers).

name: Spec.KernelB.kernel_b_settlement_chunk_refusals
description: KB.refusals: for all six `u128` inputs, with `limit = min(chunk_atoms, endpoint_loss_atom_budget)`, `D = SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN` and exact arithmetic, if `V16Core::kernel_b_settlement_chunk(..)` returns, it returns `Err(RecoveryRequired)` exactly when `target < b_snap`, or `target > b_snap` and (`loss_weight == 0` or `endpoint_loss_atom_budget == 0` or (`(limit + 1) * D < 2^128` and `b_rem + loss_weight >= (limit + 1) * D`)); and it returns `Err(ArithmeticOverflow)` exactly when `target > b_snap`, `loss_weight != 0`, `endpoint_loss_atom_budget != 0` and `(limit + 1) * D >= 2^128` (i.e. `limit >= 340282366920938463`).

name: Spec.KernelB.kernel_b_settlement_chunk_progress

name: Spec.KernelB.kernel_b_settlement_chunk_nopanic
description: KB.nopanic: for all six `u128` inputs, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_b_settlement_chunk(b_snap, b_rem, loss_weight, target, chunk_atoms, endpoint_loss_atom_budget)` panics (no overflow-check, divide-by-zero or other panic).

name: Spec.KernelB.kernel_b_settlement_chunk_contract
description: KB.contract: for all six `u128` inputs, if `V16Core::kernel_b_settlement_chunk(b_snap, b_rem, loss_weight, target, chunk_atoms, endpoint_loss_atom_budget)` returns, the result satisfies its `kani::ensures` clause: on `Ok(chunk)`, `target >= b_snap`, `delta_b <= target - b_snap`, `remaining_after == target - b_snap - delta_b`; if `delta_b != 0` then `loss <= min(chunk_atoms, endpoint_loss_atom_budget)`, `new_remainder < SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN` and `loss_weight * delta_b + b_rem == loss * SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN + new_remainder` exactly with no overflow on either side; if `delta_b == 0` then `target == b_snap`, `loss == 0`, `new_remainder == b_rem`. On `Err(e)`, `e` is `RecoveryRequired` or `ArithmeticOverflow`.

name: Spec.Trade.tc8_oi_cap_gate
description: TC8, `V16Core::kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate(oi_long_before_q, oi_short_before_q, oi_long_after_q, oi_short_after_q)` (K17 of the kernel contracts, for the copy reached from the trade path): returns `Ok(())` exactly when, for each side, `after <= MAX_OI_SIDE_Q` or `after <= before`; otherwise `Err(InvalidLeg)`.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_mark_kf_stale_cohorts_contract
description: K02.contract on revision `c030aa40` (46-field `AssetStateV16`): for every in-range `asset: AssetStateV16`, `long_changed`, `short_changed` and `cohort_epoch: u64` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_mark_kf_stale_cohorts(..)` returns `Ok(a)`, then each changed side's `kf_epoch_*` is `cohort_epoch` and its `stale_account_count_*` is `asset.stored_pos_count_*`, unchanged sides keep both, the stored position counts are unchanged and every other field equals `asset`'s (`kf_cohort_frame_eq`, which covers `raw_basis_sum_long_q` and `raw_basis_sum_short_q`). If it returns `Err(_)`, then `(long_changed && cohort_epoch <= asset.kf_epoch_long) || (short_changed && cohort_epoch <= asset.kf_epoch_short)`.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_clear_leg_nopanic
description: K34.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range input (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_clear_leg(..)` (including its call to `kernel_normalize_social_loss_carry`) panics.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_clear_leg_contract
description: K34.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range `leg`, `asset` and `clear_effective_oi_q: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_clear_leg(..)` returns `Ok(a)`, then `a` is the record the `ensures` describes. On `leg.side`, `stored_pos_count_*` falls by one, and `pending_obligation_count_*` falls by one if `leg.basis_pos_q == 0 && leg.loss_weight != 0`. Unless the leg predates a side reset (`mode_* == ResetPending && leg.epoch_snap.checked_add(1) == Some(epoch_*)`), also: `oi_eff_*_q` falls by `clear_effective_oi_q`, `raw_basis_sum_*_q` by `leg.basis_pos_q.unsigned_abs()`, `loss_weight_sum_*` by `leg.loss_weight`, and the side's social-loss dust and explicit unallocated loss are folded with `leg.b_rem` as in the clause. Every other field is unchanged.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_attach_leg_contract
description: K35.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range `asset`, `side`, `loss_weight: u128`, `asset_index_u32: u32` and `basis_pos_q: i128` with `basis_pos_q != 0 && basis_pos_q > i128::MIN` (the `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_attach_leg(..)` returns `Ok((a, l))`, then `l` is exactly the leg the `ensures` lists (active, `asset_index_u32`, `asset.market_id`, `side`, `basis_pos_q`, `loss_weight`, `b_rem == 0`, not stale, and the side's `a_*`, `k_*`, `f_*_num`, `kf_epoch_*`, `b_*_num`, `epoch_*` snapshots), `l.a_basis == ADL_ONE`, and `a` equals `asset` except that on `side` `oi_eff_*_q` and `raw_basis_sum_*_q` grow by `basis_pos_q.unsigned_abs()`, `loss_weight_sum_*` by `loss_weight` and `stored_pos_count_*` by 1.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_attach_leg_nopanic
description: K35.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range input with `basis_pos_q != 0 && basis_pos_q > i128::MIN`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_attach_leg(..)` (including its call to `add_open_interest_for_new_position`) panics.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_retain_leg_as_pending_obligation_nopanic
description: K32.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range input (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_retain_leg_as_pending_obligation(..)` panics.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_retain_leg_as_pending_obligation_contract
description: K32.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range `leg`, `asset` and `retained_effective_oi_q: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_retain_leg_as_pending_obligation(..)` returns `Ok((l, a))`, then `l.active`, and `l` is `leg` with `basis_pos_q == 0`. The record `a` is `asset` except on `leg.side`: `oi_eff_*_q == asset.oi_eff_*_q.wrapping_sub(retained_effective_oi_q)`, `raw_basis_sum_*_q == asset.raw_basis_sum_*_q.wrapping_sub(leg.basis_pos_q.unsigned_abs())` and `pending_obligation_count_* == asset.pending_obligation_count_*.wrapping_add(1)`.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_resize_leg_same_side_nopanic
description: K07.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range input with `new_signed != 0`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_resize_leg_same_side(..)` (including its calls to `adjust_u128`) panics.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_resize_leg_same_side_contract
description: K07.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for every in-range input with `new_signed != 0` (the `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_resize_leg_same_side(leg, asset, new_signed, new_weight, preserve_pending_obligation_weight, old_effective_abs, new_effective_abs)` returns `Ok((l, a))`, then `l` is `leg` with `basis_pos_q == new_signed` and `loss_weight == (if preserve_pending_obligation_weight { leg.loss_weight } else { new_weight })`. And `a` is `asset` except on `leg.side`: `oi_eff_*_q == asset.oi_eff_*_q.wrapping_sub(old_effective_abs).wrapping_add(new_effective_abs)`, `raw_basis_sum_*_q == asset.raw_basis_sum_*_q.wrapping_sub(leg.basis_pos_q.unsigned_abs()).wrapping_add(new_signed.unsigned_abs())`, and unless the flag is set `loss_weight_sum_* == asset.loss_weight_sum_*.wrapping_sub(leg.loss_weight).wrapping_add(new_weight)`. This is every clause of the `ensures`.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction_progress
description: K60.progress (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` arguments with `raw_sum <= 2 * MAX_OI_SIDE_Q`, if `V16Core::kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction(raw, e, e2, oi, raw_sum)` returns `Ok(next_raw)`, then `1 <= next_raw < raw`, `oi - (e - e2) <= (raw_sum - raw) + next_raw` in exact integer arithmetic, and `oi == raw_sum` implies `next_raw == e2`. No other precondition (in particular not `raw <= raw_sum`) is assumed.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction_nopanic
description: K60.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` arguments with `raw_basis_sum_q <= ADL_ONE && raw_abs_q <= raw_basis_sum_q`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction(..)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow (the `-`, `+` and `checked_mul` steps) or division or remainder by zero.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction_contract
description: K60.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` arguments with `raw_basis_sum_q <= ADL_ONE && raw_abs_q <= raw_basis_sum_q` (the `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_raw_basis_after_adl_reduction(raw_abs_q, effective_abs_q, next_effective_abs_q, oi_eff_q, raw_basis_sum_q)` returns `Ok(next_raw)`, then with `reduce_q = effective_abs_q.wrapping_sub(next_effective_abs_q)`, `oi_after = oi_eff_q.wrapping_sub(reduce_q)` and `other_raw = raw_basis_sum_q.wrapping_sub(raw_abs_q)`: `next_effective_abs_q != 0`, `next_effective_abs_q < effective_abs_q <= oi_eff_q <= raw_basis_sum_q`, `1 <= next_raw < raw_abs_q`, `oi_after <= other_raw.wrapping_add(next_raw)`, and `oi_eff_q != raw_basis_sum_q || next_raw == next_effective_abs_q`. The `Err` arm is `true`.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_side_adl_index_exposure
description: K59.exposure (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` values `oi`, `raw_sum`, `a` with `raw_sum <= 2 * MAX_OI_SIDE_Q`, if `V16Core::kernel_side_adl_index(oi, raw_sum, a)` returns `Ok(A)` with `raw_sum > 0` and `oi > 0`, then `A * raw_sum <= ADL_ONE * oi < (A + 1) * raw_sum` in exact integer arithmetic.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_side_adl_index_nopanic
description: K59.nopanic (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` values `oi_eff_q`, `raw_basis_sum_q`, `current_a` with `raw_basis_sum_q <= ADL_ONE`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_side_adl_index(..)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow or division by zero.

name: Spec.KernelC.kernel_side_adl_index_contract
description: K59.contract (revision `c030aa40`): for all `u128` values `oi_eff_q`, `raw_basis_sum_q`, `current_a` with `raw_basis_sum_q <= ADL_ONE` (the `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_side_adl_index(..)` returns `Ok(a)` then: `a == current_a` when `raw_basis_sum_q == 0`; otherwise `oi_eff_q <= raw_basis_sum_q`, `1 <= a <= ADL_ONE`, `(a == ADL_ONE) == (oi_eff_q == raw_basis_sum_q)`, `oi_eff_q == 0 || a.wrapping_mul(raw_basis_sum_q) <= ADL_ONE.wrapping_mul(oi_eff_q)`, `ADL_ONE.wrapping_mul(oi_eff_q) < a.wrapping_add(1).wrapping_mul(raw_basis_sum_q)` and `oi_eff_q != 0 || a == 1`; if it returns `Err(e)` then `e == V16Error::InvalidLeg`, `raw_basis_sum_q != 0` and `oi_eff_q > raw_basis_sum_q`.

name: Spec.WideMath.G5_split_loses_lt_one
description: G5. For weights with `w1 + w2 = W` (exact sum) and `W != 0`, and any `X`: if `mul_div_floor_u256(X, w1, W)` returns `r1` and then `mul_div_floor_u256(X, w2, W)` returns `r2`, then `val(r1) + val(r2)` is `val(X)` or `val(X) - 1`.

name: Spec.WideMath.G4_share_le_whole
description: G4. For `val(d) != 0` and `val(b) <= val(d)`: if `mul_div_floor_u256(a, b, d)` returns `x`, then `val(x) <= val(a)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.G3_monotone
description: G3. For `val(d) != 0` and `val(a) <= val(a')`: if `mul_div_floor_u256(a, b, d)` returns `x` and then `mul_div_floor_u256(a', b, d)` returns `x'`, then `val(x) <= val(x')`; and the same for `mul_div_ceil_u256`.

name: Spec.WideMath.G2_floor_ceil_bracket
description: G2. For `val(d) != 0`: if `mul_div_floor_u256(a, b, d)` returns `x` then `val(x) * val(d) <= val(a)*val(b)`, and if `mul_div_ceil_u256(a, b, d)` returns `y` then `val(a)*val(b) <= val(y) * val(d)` (each half holds whenever that call returns).

name: Spec.WideMath.G1_ceil_minus_floor
description: G1. For `val(d) != 0`: if `mul_div_floor_u256(a, b, d)` returns `x` and then `mul_div_ceil_u256(a, b, d)` returns `y`, then `val(y) - val(x)` is `0` when `val(d)` divides `val(a)*val(b)` and `1` otherwise.

name: Spec.WideMath.E5_wide_signed_mul_div_floor_from_k_pair_panics
description: E5, exact panic conditions (asked for every caller of `abs_u256`). With `F = floor(abs_basis * (k_now - k_then) / den)`: every execution of `wide_signed_mul_div_floor_from_k_pair(abs_basis, k_then, k_now, den)` panics exactly when `den = 0` or `|F| >= 2^127` (so the representable result `i128::MIN` is also refused); otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `F`. Since `|k_now - k_then| < 2^128`, the difference is never `I256::MIN` and the assertion of `abs_u256` is never reached.

name: Spec.WideMath.E5_wide_signed_mul_div_floor_from_k_pair
description: E5. `wide_signed_mul_div_floor_from_k_pair(abs_basis, k_then, k_now, den)`: every execution with `den = 0` panics; for `den != 0`, if the call returns `x`, then `x = floor(abs_basis * (k_now - k_then) / den)` with the exact integer difference `k_now - k_then`.

name: Spec.WideMath.E4_wide_signed_mul_div_floor_panics
description: E4, exact panic conditions (asked for every caller of `abs_u256`). Every execution of `wide_signed_mul_div_floor(abs_basis, k_diff, denominator)` panics exactly when `WsmdPanics A k D` holds; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is the two's-complement wrap of `F = floor(A*k/D)` into `I256` (equal to `F` when `F` is in range; for `k > 0` and `2^255 <= F < 2^256` it is `F - 2^256`). The function's own `assert!(k_diff != I256::MIN)` fires before `abs_u256` is called, so the assertion of `abs_u256` is never reached.

name: Spec.WideMath.E4_wide_signed_mul_div_floor
description: E4. With `F = floor(val(abs_basis) * sval(k_diff) / val(denominator))`: every execution of `wide_signed_mul_div_floor(abs_basis, k_diff, denominator)` with `val(denominator) = 0` panics; for `val(denominator) != 0`, if the call returns `x` and `F` lies in `[-2^255, 2^255)`, then `sval(x) = F`.

name: Spec.WideMath.E3_floor_div_signed_conservative_i128
description: E3. `floor_div_signed_conservative_i128(n, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `d = 0` or (`n = i128::MIN` and `d = 1`); otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `floor(n/d)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.E2_floor_div_signed_conservative_panics
description: E2. For `val(d) != 0`: no execution of `floor_div_signed_conservative(n, d)` panics unless `sval(n) = -2^255` and `val(d) = 1`, and the result is `floor(sval(n)/val(d))`; for `sval(n) = -2^255`, `val(d) = 1` every execution panics (the result `2^255` is not representable; `checked_neg` of `I256::MIN` fails). The exception is exact. `abs_u256` is called only for `sval(n) >= 0`, so its `I256::MIN` assertion is never reached by this function.

name: Spec.WideMath.E1_floor_div_signed_conservative
description: E1. `floor_div_signed_conservative(n, d)`: every execution with `val(d) = 0` panics; for `val(d) != 0`, if the call returns `x`, then `sval(x) = floor(sval(n)/val(d))`. (Its exact panic conditions for `val(d) != 0` are E2.)

name: wide_signed_mul_div_floor.no_return_when_f_ge_2_255
description: E4b (as stated in the spec file). `wide_signed_mul_div_floor` does not return when `F = floor(val(abs_basis) * sval(k_diff) / val(denominator)) >= 2^255`.

name: Spec.WideMath.F4_wide_mul_div_ceil_u128_or_over_i128max
description: F4. `wide_mul_div_ceil_u128_or_over_i128max(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `d = 0`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `Ok(c)` with `c = ceil(a*b/d)` when `c <= i128::MAX`, and `Err(OverI128Magnitude)` otherwise.

name: Spec.WideMath.F3_wide_mul_div_floor_u128
description: F3. `wide_mul_div_floor_u128(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `d = 0` or `floor(a*b/d) >= 2^128` (the product is formed exactly); otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `floor(a*b/d)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.F2_mul_div_ceil_u128
description: F2. `mul_div_ceil_u128(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `d = 0` or `a*b >= 2^128`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `ceil(a*b/d)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.F1_mul_div_floor_u128
description: F1. `mul_div_floor_u128(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `d = 0` or `a*b >= 2^128`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `floor(a*b/d)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.D7_checked_mul_div_ceil_u256
description: D7. `checked_mul_div_ceil_u256(a, b, d)`: no execution panics; if it returns, the result is `Some(c)` with `val(c) = ceil(val(a)*val(b)/val(d))` exactly when `val(d) != 0` and that ceiling is below `2^256`, and `None` otherwise.

name: Spec.WideMath.D6_mul_div_ceil_u256
description: D6. `mul_div_ceil_u256(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `val(d) = 0` or `ceil(val(a)*val(b)/val(d)) >= 2^256`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `ceil(val(a)*val(b)/val(d))`.

name: Spec.WideMath.D5_mul_div_floor_u256_with_rem
description: D5. `mul_div_floor_u256_with_rem(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `val(d) = 0` or `floor(val(a)*val(b)/val(d)) >= 2^256`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns `(q, r)`, then `val(a)*val(b) = val(q)*val(d) + val(r)` and `val(r) < val(d)`.

name: Spec.WideMath.D4_mul_div_floor_u256
description: D4. `mul_div_floor_u256(a, b, d)`: every execution panics exactly when `val(d) = 0` or `floor(val(a)*val(b)/val(d)) >= 2^256`; otherwise no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `floor(val(a)*val(b)/val(d))` (the product is formed exactly in 512 bits).

name: Spec.WideMath.C3_ceil_div_positive_checked
description: C3. `ceil_div_positive_checked(n, d)`: every execution with `val(d) = 0` panics; for `val(d) != 0` no execution panics and, if it returns, the result is `ceil(val(n)/val(d))` (the `checked_add` overflow is unreachable because the ceiling never exceeds `val(n)`).

name: Spec.WideMath.B9_div_rem_operators
description: B9 (`/` and `%` parts). For all `U256` values `a`, `b`: if `val(b) != 0`, no execution of `a / b` (resp. `a % b`) panics and the result is `floor(val(a)/val(b))` (resp. `val(a) mod val(b)`), i.e. the value of the checked form; if `val(b) = 0` (exactly when the checked form is `None`), every execution panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B4_checked_div_rem
description: B4. For all `U256` values `a`, `b`: no execution of `a.checked_div(b)` or `a.checked_rem(b)` panics; they return `None` exactly when `val(b) = 0`, and otherwise `Some` of `floor(val(a)/val(b))` and `Some` of `val(a) mod val(b)` respectively.

name: Spec.WideMath.D3_checked_div_rem_nonzero
description: D3 (nonzero divisor half). For every `self` and every `den` with `val(den) != 0`, with `Q = floor(val(self)/val(den))` and `R = val(self) mod val(den)`: no execution of `U512::checked_div_rem_by_u256(self, den)` panics, and if it returns, the result is `Some((q, r))` with `val(q) = Q`, `val(r) = R` exactly when `Q < 2^256`, and `None` exactly when `Q >= 2^256`. The zero-divisor half is `checked-div-rem-by-u256-zero-spec` (proved).

name: Spec.WideMath.C2_div_rem_u256_value
description: C2. For every `num` and every `den` with `val(den) != 0`, if `div_rem_u256(num, den)` returns `(q, r)`, then `val(num) = val(q) * val(den) + val(r)` and `val(r) < val(den)` (and no execution panics).

name: Spec.WideMath.C1_div_rem_u256_nonzero_no_panic
description: C1 (nonzero divisor half). For every `num` and every `den` with `val(den) != 0`, no execution of `div_rem_u256(num, den)` panics. Together with the proved zero-divisor half (`div-rem-u256-zero-spec`: every execution with `val(den) = 0` panics), this gives "panics exactly when `val(den) = 0`".

name: Spec.WideMath.A6_i256_constants
description: A6, constant part: `I256::ZERO`, `ONE`, `MINUS_ONE`, `MAX` and `MIN` have `sval` `0`, `1`, `-1`, `2^255 - 1` and `-2^255`, observed through a harness that compiles the unchanged `src/wide_math.rs` and returns each constant from a function; no execution of those functions panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A2_u256_constants
description: A2, constant part: `U256::ZERO`, `U256::ONE` and `U256::MAX` have values `0`, `1` and `2^256 - 1`, observed through a harness that compiles the unchanged `src/wide_math.rs` and returns each constant from a function; no execution of those functions panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A6_i256_sign
description: A6, method part: `I256::is_zero`, `is_negative`, `is_positive` and `signum` agree with the sign of `sval(x)` (`signum` returns `-1`, `0` or `1`), and no execution panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A2_u256_is_zero
description: A2, method part: `x.is_zero()` returns `true` exactly when `val(x) = 0`, and no execution panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A7_abs_u256_min_panics
description: `I256::MIN.abs_u256()`: every execution panics, because the `assert!(self != Self::MIN, ...)` in the body fails. So the call never returns normally, and in particular never returns `2^255`.

name: Spec.WideMath.A7_i256_abs_u256
description: A7. For every `x : I256`, including `I256::MIN`: if `x.abs_u256()` returns, the result is the `U256` with `val = |sval(x)|`. As agreed, this is a property about returned values and says nothing about inputs on which the call panics. On `I256::MIN` the call never returns: every execution panics (row `a7-abs-u256-min-panics`), so for that input the clause "(value `2^255`)" holds only vacuously. For every other `x`, no execution panics (row `a7-abs-u256-not-min`).

name: Spec.WideMath.D8_saturating_mul
description: D8. `saturating_mul_u256_u64(a, b)` returns the `U256` of value `min(val(a) * b, 2^256 - 1)`; `saturating_mul_u128_u64(a, b)` returns `min(a * b, 2^128 - 1)`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.E6_i256_checked
description: E6. `I256::checked_add`, `checked_sub` and `checked_neg` return `Some` of the exact integer result exactly when it lies in `[-2^255, 2^255)`, otherwise `None`; `I256::checked_mul_i256` returns `Some` of the exact product exactly when it lies in that range, otherwise `None`; `I256::saturating_add` returns the exact sum clamped to that range. None of them panics. The `checked_mul_i256` part assumes the documented behaviour of `PartialOrd::gt` on `U256` (`GtU256Contract`).

name: Spec.WideMath.B9_operators
description: B9 (operators `+ - * << >> & | += -=` of `U256`): `a + b`, `a - b`, `a * b` return the B1/B2/B3 value and no execution panics when the checked form is `Some`, and every execution panics when it is `None`; `a << n`, `a >> n`, `a & b`, `a | b` return the B7/B8 values and no execution panics; `a += b` / `a -= b` store the B1/B2 value into `a` (no panic) when the checked form is `Some` and every execution panics when it is `None`. `/` and `%` are not covered here.

name: Spec.WideMath.B8_bitwise
description: B8. `a.bitand(b)` and `a.bitor(b)` return the `U256` whose value is the bitwise AND / OR of `val(a)` and `val(b)`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B7_shifts
description: B7. For every `u32` shift amount `n`: `a.shl(n)` returns the `U256` of value `(val(a) * 2^n) mod 2^256` for `n < 256` and `0` for `n >= 256`; `a.shr(n)` returns the `U256` of value `floor(val(a) / 2^n)` for `n < 256` and `0` for `n >= 256`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B6_saturating
description: B6. `a.saturating_add(b)` returns the `U256` of value `min(val(a) + val(b), 2^256 - 1)`; `a.saturating_sub(b)` returns the `U256` of value `max(val(a) - val(b), 0)`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B5_overflowing
description: B5. `a.overflowing_add(b)` returns `((val(a) + val(b)) mod 2^256, carry)` with `carry` true exactly when the sum is at least `2^256`; `a.overflowing_sub(b)` returns `((val(a) - val(b)) mod 2^256, borrow)` with `borrow` true exactly when `val(a) < val(b)`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B3_checked_mul
description: B3. `a.checked_mul(b)` returns `Some(c)` with `val(c) = val(a) * val(b)` exactly when that product is below `2^256`, otherwise `None`, and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B2_checked_sub
description: B2. `a.checked_sub(b)` returns `Some(c)` with `val(c) = val(a) - val(b)` exactly when `val(a) >= val(b)`, otherwise `None`, and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.B1_checked_add
description: B1. `a.checked_add(b)` returns `Some(c)` with `val(c) = val(a) + val(b)` exactly when that sum is below `2^256`, otherwise `None`, and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A7_abs_u256_not_min
description: A7 restricted to `x != I256::MIN`: `x.abs_u256()` returns the `U256` with `val = |sval(x)|` and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A4_u256_eq_ord
description: A4. The derived `<U256 as PartialEq>::eq` returns `true` exactly when `val(a) = val(b)`; `<U256 as Ord>::cmp` returns the order of `val(a)` and `val(b)`; `<U256 as PartialOrd>::partial_cmp` returns `Some` of that order. None of them panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A3_u256_try_into_u128
description: A3. `x.try_into_u128()` returns `Some(val(x))` exactly when `val(x) < 2^128`, otherwise `None`, and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A1_u256_representation
description: A1. `U256::new(lo, hi)` returns the `U256` with `val = lo + 2^128*hi`; `x.lo()` and `x.hi()` return the low and high 128 bits of `val(x)` (and give the borrowed `x` back); `U256::from_u128(v)` and `U256::from_u64(v)` return the `U256` with `val = v`. No execution of these calls panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.F5_fee_debt
description: F5. `fee_debt_u128_checked(x)` returns `-x` for `x < 0` (including `2^127` for `i128::MIN`) and `0` otherwise, and never panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A8_i256_from_raw
description: A8. `I256::from_raw_u256(v)` reinterprets the limbs: its `sval` is `val(v)` if `val(v) < 2^255`, else `val(v) - 2^256`. `I256::from_u256_or_overflow(v)` returns `Some` of that `I256` exactly when `val(v) < 2^255`, otherwise `None`. Neither panics.

name: Spec.WideMath.A5_i256_conversions
description: A5. `I256::from_i128(v)` and `I256::from_u128(v)` return the `I256` with `sval = v`; `x.try_into_i128()` returns `Some(sval(x))` exactly when `sval(x)` fits in `i128`, otherwise `None`. None of them panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.health_requirements_from_base_and_target_lag_contract

name: Spec.Kernel.prepare_source_positive_claim_burn_delta_nopanic
description: K05.nopanic: for every in-range `source` and `face_burn_num: u128` satisfying the `requires`, no execution of `V16Core::prepare_source_positive_claim_burn_delta(source, face_burn_num)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow.

name: Spec.Kernel.prepare_source_positive_claim_burn_delta_contract
description: K05.contract: for every in-range `source` and `face_burn_num: u128` with `source.exact_positive_claim_num <= source.positive_claim_bound_num && face_burn_num <= source.positive_claim_bound_num` (the `requires`), if `V16Core::prepare_source_positive_claim_burn_delta(source, face_burn_num)` returns `Ok(s)`, then `s.positive_claim_bound_num == source.positive_claim_bound_num.wrapping_sub(face_burn_num)`, `s.exact_positive_claim_num == source.exact_positive_claim_num.wrapping_sub(face_burn_num.min(source.exact_positive_claim_num))`, and the other ten fields are unchanged; an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.Kernel.available_backing_num_for_source_credit_state_nopanic
description: K04.nopanic: for every in-range `state: SourceCreditStateV16` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::available_backing_num_for_source_credit_state(state)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow.

name: Spec.Kernel.available_backing_num_for_source_credit_state_contract
description: K04.contract: for every in-range `state: SourceCreditStateV16` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::available_backing_num_for_source_credit_state(state)` returns `Ok(a)`, then `fresh_reserved_backing_num >= valid_liened_backing_num`, `insurance_credit_reserved_num >= valid_liened_insurance_num.wrapping_add(impaired_liened_insurance_num)`, and `a == fresh_reserved_backing_num.wrapping_sub(valid_liened_backing_num) + (insurance_credit_reserved_num - valid_liened_insurance_num - impaired_liened_insurance_num)` (outer `+`/`-` exact); an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.Kernel.asset_restart_next_counters_u64_nopanic
description: K57.nopanic: for any `u64` arguments, no execution of `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, u64>::asset_restart_next_counters(..)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow. A counter at `u64::MAX` yields `Err(V16Error::CounterOverflow)` instead.

name: Spec.Kernel.trade_signed_size_deltas_u64_nopanic
description: K58.nopanic: for any `i128` `size_q`, including `i128::MIN`, no execution of `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, u64>::trade_signed_size_deltas(size_q)` panics, including by arithmetic overflow.

name: Spec.Kernel.trade_signed_size_deltas_u64_contract
description: K58.contract: for any `i128` `size_q`, if `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, u64>::trade_signed_size_deltas(size_q)` returns, the result is either `Ok((abs, long_d, short_d))` with `abs == size_q.unsigned_abs()`, `abs <= MAX_TRADE_SIZE_Q`, `long_d == size_q`, `short_d == -size_q`, `long_d + short_d == 0` and `size_q != 0`, or some `Err(_)`.

name: Spec.Kernel.asset_restart_next_counters_u64_contract
description: K57.contract: for any `u64` arguments `next_market_id_before`, `activation_count_before`, `asset_set_epoch_before` and `risk_epoch_before`, if `MarketGroupV16ViewMut::<'_, u64>::asset_restart_next_counters(..)` returns, the result is either `Ok((m, a, ase, re))` with `m == next_market_id_before.wrapping_add(1)`, `a == activation_count_before.wrapping_add(1)`, `ase == asset_set_epoch_before.wrapping_add(1)` and `re == risk_epoch_before.wrapping_add(1)`, or some `Err(_)`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_recovery_pending_obligation_release_allowed_nopanic
description: K33.nopanic: for every `lifecycle` and `opposite_stored_count, opposite_pending_count: u64` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_recovery_pending_obligation_release_allowed(..)` panics. Same read-only-constant condition as K33.contract.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_recovery_pending_obligation_release_allowed_contract
description: K33.contract: for every `lifecycle: AssetLifecycleV16` and `opposite_stored_count, opposite_pending_count: u64` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_recovery_pending_obligation_release_allowed(..)` returns, it is `Ok(allowed)` with `allowed == (lifecycle != AssetLifecycleV16::Recovery || opposite_stored_count == opposite_pending_count)`, or `Err(_)` with `opposite_pending_count > opposite_stored_count` (its `kani::ensures`). Condition: the promoted constant `&AssetLifecycleV16::Recovery` that the body compares against is present in read-only memory, as it is in the compiled crate.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_cert_is_current_nopanic
description: K22.nopanic: for every in-range `cert`, epochs and `account_bitmap` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_cert_is_current(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_cert_is_current_contract
description: K22.contract: for every in-range `cert: HealthCertV16`, `oracle_epoch, funding_epoch, risk_epoch, asset_set_epoch: u64` and `account_bitmap: V16ActiveBitmap` (`[u64; 1]`; no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_cert_is_current(..)` returns, the result equals `cert.valid && cert.cert_oracle_epoch == oracle_epoch && cert.cert_funding_epoch == funding_epoch && cert.cert_risk_epoch == risk_epoch && cert.cert_asset_set_epoch == asset_set_epoch && cert.active_bitmap_at_cert == account_bitmap` (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_reduce_position_delta_nopanic
description: K18.nopanic: for all in-range `pre_basis_signed`, `side` and `requested` satisfying its `kani::requires`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_reduce_position_delta(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_reduce_position_delta_contract
description: K18.contract: for all `pre_basis_signed: i128`, `side: SideV16` and `requested: u128` with `pre_basis_signed > i128::MIN` and `pre_basis_signed >= 0` for `Long` / `<= 0` for `Short` (its `kani::requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_reduce_position_delta(..)` returns, it is `Ok((reduce_q, delta))` with `reduce_q == min(requested, |pre|)`, `reduce_q <= |pre|`, `new.unsigned_abs() == |pre| - reduce_q` for `new = pre_basis_signed.wrapping_add(delta)`, `new.unsigned_abs() <= |pre|`, a full close giving `new == 0`, and strict progress when `|pre| > 0 && requested > 0` (its `kani::ensures`), or an `Err(_)`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_classify_position_delta_nopanic
description: K16.nopanic: for all `current, new: i128` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_classify_position_delta(current, new)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_classify_position_delta_contract
description: K16.contract: for all `current, new: i128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_classify_position_delta(current, new)` returns a route, then `Attach` implies `current == 0`; `Clear` implies `current != 0 && new == 0`; `Flip` implies `current != 0 && new != 0 && current.signum() != new.signum()`; `Resize` implies `current != 0 && new != 0 && current.signum() == new.signum()` (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate_nopanic
description: K17.nopanic: for all four `u128` side OI values (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate_contract
description: K17.contract: for all `oi_long_before_q, oi_short_before_q, oi_long_after_q, oi_short_after_q: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_trade_side_oi_cap_gate(..)` returns, it is `Ok(())` where each side satisfies `after <= MAX_OI_SIDE_Q || after <= before`, or `Err(e)` where `e == V16Error::InvalidLeg` and some side has `after > MAX_OI_SIDE_Q && after > before` (its `kani::ensures`; `MAX_OI_SIDE_Q = 100_000_000_000_000`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_bresidual_step_nopanic
description: K27.nopanic: for all in-range `residual_remaining`, `booked` and `resolved` satisfying its `kani::requires`, no execution of `V16Core::kernel_bresidual_step(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_bresidual_step_contract
description: K27.contract: for all `residual_remaining: u128`, in-range `booked: Option<BResidualBookingOutcomeV16>` and `resolved: bool` satisfying its `kani::requires` (a `Some(o)` has `o.booked_loss.checked_add(o.explicit_loss).and_then(|v| v.checked_add(o.remaining_after)) == Some(residual_remaining)`), if `V16Core::kernel_bresidual_step(..)` returns a step, every `BResidualStepV16::Outcome(o)` result satisfies that same conservation equation (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_social_loss_chunk_cap_nopanic
description: K25.nopanic: for all `residual_remaining, public_chunk_cap: u128` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_social_loss_chunk_cap(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_social_loss_chunk_cap_contract
description: K25.contract: for all `residual_remaining, public_chunk_cap: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_social_loss_chunk_cap(..)` returns `r`, then `r == if residual_remaining < public_chunk_cap { residual_remaining } else { public_chunk_cap }`, `r <= residual_remaining` and `r <= public_chunk_cap` (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.actionable_summary_from_signals_nopanic
description: K23.nopanic: for all eight `bool` signals (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::actionable_summary_from_signals(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.actionable_summary_from_signals_contract
description: K23.contract: for all eight `bool` signals (no `requires`), if `V16Core::actionable_summary_from_signals(stale, b_stale, pending_close, expired_close, liquidatable, source_liens_releasable, recovery_eligible, resolved_winner)` returns `r`, each field of `r` equals the signal of the same name (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_open_close_snapshot_is_stale_nopanic
description: K24.nopanic: for all `originating_leg_active: bool` and `originating_asset_slot, drift_reference_slot: u64` (no `requires`), no execution of `V16Core::kernel_open_close_snapshot_is_stale(..)` panics.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_open_close_snapshot_is_stale_contract
description: K24.contract: for all `originating_leg_active: bool` and `originating_asset_slot, drift_reference_slot: u64` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_open_close_snapshot_is_stale(..)` returns, the result equals `originating_leg_active && originating_asset_slot > drift_reference_slot` (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_resolved_payout_step_nopanic
description: K13.nopanic: for all `claimable, vault: u128`, `V16Core::kernel_resolved_payout_step(claimable, vault)` does not panic; in particular the overflow-checked `vault - payout` never overflows.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_resolved_payout_step_contract
description: K13.contract: for all `claimable, vault: u128`, if `V16Core::kernel_resolved_payout_step(claimable, vault)` returns `(payout, new_vault)`, then `payout == min(claimable, vault)`, `payout <= claimable`, `payout <= vault`, `new_vault == vault - payout` and `new_vault.wrapping_add(payout) == vault` (its `kani::ensures`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_consume_insurance_layer_nopanic
description: K12.nopanic: for all `domain_available, insurance, spent: u128` and `pnl: i128` with `pnl < 0 && pnl > i128::MIN`, `V16Core::kernel_consume_insurance_layer(..)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_consume_insurance_layer_contract
description: K12.contract: for all `domain_available, insurance, spent: u128` and `pnl: i128` with `pnl < 0 && pnl > i128::MIN`, if `V16Core::kernel_consume_insurance_layer(..)` returns `Ok((used, new_insurance, new_spent, new_pnl))` then every conjunct of its `kani::ensures` holds (`used == min(|pnl|, domain_available)`, `new_insurance == insurance - used`, `new_spent == spent + used`, `new_pnl == pnl + used`, `new_pnl <= 0`, ...); an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_forfeit_residual_step_nopanic
description: K28.nopanic: for all `residual_remaining`, `booking_capacity: u128` (no `requires`), `V16Core::kernel_forfeit_residual_step(..)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_normalize_social_loss_carry_nopanic
description: K31.nopanic: for all `remainder`, `dust`, `explicit_loss: u128` (no `requires`), `V16Core::kernel_normalize_social_loss_carry(..)` does not panic (the overflow-checked `total - SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN` runs only when `total >= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_retain_terminal_source_haircut_nopanic
description: K15.nopanic: for all `positive_pnl`, `reserved_pnl`, `source_attributed_face`, `converted: u128` (no `requires`), `V16Core::kernel_retain_terminal_source_haircut(..)` does not panic (both overflow-checked subtractions are guarded).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_released_pnl_conversion_partition_nopanic
description: K14.nopanic: for all `positive_face`, `converted`, `source_face_burn: u128` and `retain_haircut_face: bool` (no `requires`), `V16Core::kernel_released_pnl_conversion_partition(..)` does not panic (the checked `source_face_burn - converted` cannot overflow).

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_initial_margin_gate_nopanic
description: K08.nopanic: for every in-range `cert: HealthCertV16` (no `requires`), `V16Core::kernel_initial_margin_gate(cert)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_locked_margin_gate_nopanic
description: K09.nopanic: for all `capital, certified_initial_req: u128` and `pnl, fee_credits: i128` with `pnl > i128::MIN && fee_credits > i128::MIN && capital < 1u128 << 100`, `V16Core::kernel_locked_margin_gate(capital, pnl, fee_credits, certified_initial_req)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_settle_resolved_pnl_after_booking_nopanic
description: K29.nopanic: for all `pnl: i128` with `pnl < 0 && pnl > i128::MIN` and all `booked_loss, explicit_loss: u128`, `V16Core::kernel_settle_resolved_pnl_after_booking(pnl, booked_loss, explicit_loss)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_settle_principal_nopanic
description: K11.nopanic: for all `capital, c_tot: u128` and `pnl: i128` with `pnl <= 0 && pnl > i128::MIN`, `V16Core::kernel_settle_principal(capital, c_tot, pnl)` does not panic.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_forfeit_residual_step_contract
description: K28.contract: for all `residual_remaining`, `booking_capacity: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_forfeit_residual_step(..)` returns `r: ForfeitResidualStepV16`, then `NoResidual` implies `residual_remaining == 0`, `Book` implies `residual_remaining != 0 && booking_capacity != 0`, and `CommitRecovery` implies `residual_remaining != 0 && booking_capacity == 0`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_normalize_social_loss_carry_contract
description: K31.contract: for all `remainder`, `dust`, `explicit_loss: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_normalize_social_loss_carry(..)` returns, then with `total = remainder.wrapping_add(dust)` either it is `Ok((next_dust, next_explicit))` with `remainder < SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`, `dust < SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`, `next_dust == if total >= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN { total.wrapping_sub(SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN) } else { total }`, `next_explicit == explicit_loss.saturating_add(if total >= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN { 1 } else { 0 })`, `next_dust < SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN` and `next_explicit >= explicit_loss`; or it is `Err(_)` with `remainder >= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN || dust >= SOCIAL_LOSS_DEN`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_retain_terminal_source_haircut_contract
description: K15.contract: for all `positive_pnl`, `reserved_pnl`, `source_attributed_face`, `converted: u128` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_retain_terminal_source_haircut(..)` returns, then either it is `Ok(next_reserved)` with `reserved_pnl <= positive_pnl`, `source_attributed_face <= positive_pnl - reserved_pnl`, `converted <= source_attributed_face`, `next_reserved <= positive_pnl - converted` and `(positive_pnl - converted) - next_reserved == (positive_pnl - reserved_pnl) - source_attributed_face`; or it is `Err(_)` with `reserved_pnl > positive_pnl || source_attributed_face > positive_pnl.saturating_sub(reserved_pnl) || converted > source_attributed_face`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_released_pnl_conversion_partition_contract
description: K14.contract: for all `positive_face`, `converted`, `source_face_burn: u128` and `retain_haircut_face: bool` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_released_pnl_conversion_partition(..)` returns, then either it is `Ok((pnl_debit, retained_haircut_face))` with `converted <= source_face_burn <= positive_face`, `pnl_debit <= positive_face`, the wrapping round-trip identity, and (if `retain_haircut_face`) `pnl_debit == converted`, `retained_haircut_face == source_face_burn - converted` and the three-part wrapping sum equals `positive_face`, else `pnl_debit == source_face_burn` and `retained_haircut_face == 0`; or it is `Err(_)` with `converted > source_face_burn || source_face_burn > positive_face`.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_initial_margin_gate_contract
description: K08.contract: for every in-range `cert: HealthCertV16` (no `requires`), if `V16Core::kernel_initial_margin_gate(cert)` returns, then with `admit = cert.valid && cert.certified_equity >= 0 && (cert.certified_equity as u128) >= cert.certified_initial_req`, the result is `Ok(())` exactly when `admit` holds and an `Err(_)` exactly when it does not.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_locked_margin_gate_contract
description: K09.contract: for all `capital, certified_initial_req: u128` and `pnl, fee_credits: i128` with `pnl > i128::MIN && fee_credits > i128::MIN && capital < 1u128 << 100`, if `V16Core::kernel_locked_margin_gate(capital, pnl, fee_credits, certified_initial_req)` returns `Ok(())` then, with `equity = (capital as i128).wrapping_add(if pnl < 0 { pnl } else { 0 }).wrapping_sub(fee_credits.unsigned_abs() as i128)`, `equity >= 0 && (equity as u128) >= certified_initial_req`; an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_settle_resolved_pnl_after_booking_contract
description: K29.contract: for all `pnl: i128` with `pnl < 0 && pnl > i128::MIN` and all `booked_loss, explicit_loss: u128`, if `V16Core::kernel_settle_resolved_pnl_after_booking(pnl, booked_loss, explicit_loss)` returns `Ok(new_pnl)` then, with `loss = pnl.unsigned_abs()` and `cleared = booked_loss.saturating_add(explicit_loss).min(loss)`, `new_pnl == pnl + (cleared as i128)`, `new_pnl <= 0`, `new_pnl >= pnl` and `new_pnl.unsigned_abs() == loss - cleared`; an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.Kernel.kernel_settle_principal_contract
description: K11.contract: for all `capital, c_tot: u128` and `pnl: i128` with `pnl <= 0 && pnl > i128::MIN`, if `V16Core::kernel_settle_principal(capital, c_tot, pnl)` returns `Ok((paid, new_capital, new_c_tot, new_pnl))` then every conjunct of its `kani::ensures` holds (`paid == min(capital, |pnl|)`, `new_capital == capital - paid`, `new_c_tot == c_tot - paid`, both `wrapping_add` conservation equalities, `new_pnl == pnl + (paid as i128)`, `new_pnl <= 0`); an `Err(_)` result is allowed.

name: Spec.WideMath.checked_div_rem_by_u256_zero_spec
description: The private `U512::checked_div_rem_by_u256(self, den)` never returns normally when `val(den) = 0` (i.e. `den` is `U256::ZERO`), for every `self`; the only possible outcome is a panic.

name: Spec.WideMath.div_rem_u256_zero_spec
description: `div_rem_u256(num, den)` never returns normally when `val(den) = 0` (i.e. `den` is `U256::ZERO`), for every `num`; the only possible outcome is a panic.

name: Spec.WideMath.mul_u256_spec
description: D2: for all `a, b: U256`, the private `U512::mul_u256(a, b)` never panics, and when it returns, the result `U512` has `val = val(a) * val(b)` exactly.

name: Spec.WideMath.widening_mul_u128_spec
description: D1: for all `a, b: u128`, the private `widening_mul_u128(a, b)` never panics, and when it returns, the result `(lo, hi)` satisfies `lo + 2^128 * hi = a * b` exactly.
